Moving along the arrows: the bottom-right blank circle goes to the bottom-left blank circle with operation ×0; the bottom-left circle goes to the left circle with +6; the left circle goes to the top circle with ×4; the top circle goes to the right circle containing the question mark with −15; and the question-mark circle goes to the bottom-right circle with +4.
